steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Gather documentation of your project leadership roles, whether in nuclear research, national security, engineering, or other Oak Ridge sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend interactive sessions from anywhere, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full required contact hours—no self-paced modules, no recordings only.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing training, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the PMI exam fee directly to PMI. Verify all details carefully; incomplete applications delay your eligibility to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guides to reinforce your learning. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. PMI tracks your PDUs and renewal deadline. Plan early—project professionals in Oak Ridge's contract and government sectors often earn PDUs through ongoing training and conference attendance.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
